nodes.label: NOTE: This file should not be edited
TradeBorn
nodes.rationale: Trading research prototype only — historical research, not investment advice, no live trading.

nodes.label: Deterministic backtest engine
nodes.rationale: Reproducible results; LLM cannot invent win rates, returns, or drawdown.

nodes.label: Knowledge RAG
nodes.rationale: Citations about bias, costs, sample size on Learn explain; does not change metrics.

nodes.label: Web search
nodes.rationale: Optional agent/search — not required for core Ask→Learn demo.

nodes.label: apps/web (Next.js App Router)
nodes.rationale: Comfortable stack for product UI: routes per workflow step, React, easy local/dev deploy.

nodes.label: apps/api (Fastify)
nodes.rationale: Keeps backtesting, DB, and LLM keys off the browser; clear HTTP contract for the UI.

nodes.label: Neon Postgres + pgvector
nodes.rationale: Hosted DB without Docker Postgres; pgvector for optional RAG beside structured experiment data.

nodes.label: packages/shared (Zod schemas)
nodes.rationale: Same experiment/clarification shapes on client and server — fewer UI/API shape mismatches.

nodes.label: NIFTY50 daily OHLC CSV
nodes.rationale: Seeded sample/synthetic-style series for reproducibility — not a live exchange feed.

nodes.label: Next session open entry
nodes.rationale: Entry at next session open avoids same-bar look-ahead.

nodes.label: Simplified bps cost model
nodes.rationale: Costs are a simplified bps model, not full brokerage/taxes/impact.

nodes.label: LLM never calculates metrics
nodes.rationale: Win rate, returns, and drawdown come only from the backtest engine; AI explains frozen numbers only.

nodes.label: OpenUI Lang (allowlisted)
nodes.rationale: Controlled generative UI panels — unknown components rejected.

nodes.label: LangChain / LangGraph.js
nodes.rationale: Structured clarification + tool-shaped search/RAG without leaving the Node monorepo.

nodes.label: Look-ahead Bias
nodes.rationale: Even small amounts of look-ahead bias can inflate historical performance and create false confidence.

nodes.label: TradeBorn next-session-open mitigation
nodes.rationale: Signals evaluated at close of session t; entry at next session open (t+1) so strategy cannot trade the close it just observed.

nodes.label: Overlapping Trades
nodes.rationale: Overlaps can recount the same regime, inflate win rates, and complicate capital/risk interpretation.

nodes.label: Overlapping trades disabled by default
nodes.rationale: New signal ignored while active trade open; enable only for intentional density-of-signal analysis.

nodes.label: Small Sample Warnings
nodes.rationale: Few completed trades are exploratory not confirmatory; under ~30 trades sensitive to outliers.

nodes.label: Plain-language warnings over confidence scores
nodes.rationale: Prefer stating what data shows, what remains uncertain, and what to test next — no fake confidence scores.

nodes.label: Transaction Costs and Slippage
nodes.rationale: Historical returns without costs overstate real-world outcomes.

nodes.label: TradeBorn simplified cost model
nodes.rationale: NetReturn = GrossReturn - EntrySlippage - ExitSlippage - Fees; defaults 5 bps entry/exit slippage and 10 bps round-trip; not full brokerage/taxes/impact.

nodes.label: Search provider fallback chain
nodes.rationale: Brave → Tavily → DuckDuckGo → SearXNG → Wikipedia → MiniSearch; stops at first non-empty result.

nodes.label: RAG FTS / MiniSearch fallback
nodes.rationale: If embeddings unset or fail, retrieve_knowledge uses Postgres FTS then MiniSearch over local markdown.

nodes.label: TradeBorn
nodes.rationale: Question-to-evidence trading research workspace; transparent research copilot, not an AI that tells users which trades to make.

nodes.label: Transparency over automation
nodes.rationale: Every generated parameter must be visible and editable.

nodes.label: Reproducibility
nodes.rationale: Versioned experiment specification + dataset version should produce the same result.

nodes.label: Evidence before interpretation
nodes.rationale: Show raw metrics before AI-generated explanation.

nodes.label: Separation of concerns (LLM vs engine)
nodes.rationale: LLM interprets language and explains results; deterministic backtest engine calculates results.

nodes.label: No false precision
nodes.rationale: Communicate sample size, coverage, costs, and limitations rather than a single buy/sell answer.

nodes.label: Sharp fall condition (−5% / 5 sessions)
nodes.rationale: Close_t / Close_{t-5} - 1 ≤ −5% defines MVP sharp-fall signal.

nodes.label: Next session open entry
nodes.rationale: Avoids using information unavailable before the signal was complete.

nodes.label: Disallow overlapping trades (MVP)
nodes.rationale: Easier to explain; avoids unintentionally counting the same market event multiple times.

nodes.label: Simplified round-trip cost model
nodes.rationale: NetReturn = GrossReturn - EntrySlippage - ExitSlippage - Fees; label as simplified assumption.

nodes.label: Deterministic backtest engine
nodes.rationale: Must be independent of the LLM; unit-tested for boundary conditions.

nodes.label: OpenUI Lang
nodes.rationale: Allowlisted components only; never render arbitrary HTML/JS from model output.

nodes.label: pgvector RAG
nodes.rationale: Not required for core demo; useful for methodology citations; do not add merely for sophistication.

nodes.label: Optional web search
nodes.rationale: Do not make search a dependency for main demo; keys, rate limits, and reproducibility problems.

nodes.label: Versioned CSV dataset preference
nodes.rationale: Prefer CSV over live API for reproducibility, no API key, no rate limits, stable demo outputs, clear provenance.
